title: GPT-4 Public Introduction
summary: OpenAI publicly introduced GPT-4 on March 14, 2023. OpenAI described GPT-4 as a large multimodal model capable of accepting image and text inputs and producing text outputs.
significance: A documented public introduction of GPT-4 and a major multimodal-model milestone in OpenAI's model history.

verification.note: OpenAI's first-party GPT-4 launch page establishes the March 14, 2023 public introduction milestone and describes GPT-4 as accepting image and text inputs and producing text outputs. The GPT-4 Technical Report corroborates the multimodal capability description. The date is attached only to this documented public-introduction milestone; no internal model-completion date, geography, ancestry, influence, causal relationship, or unsupported precision is inferred.
